lunch.name: Chirashi Sushi Bowl (Scattered Sushi Rice Bowl)
lunch.description: Japanese lunch - sushi rice topped with assorted ingredients artfully arranged. Chirashi means scattered
instructions: Season warm rice with sushi vinegar
Scramble eggs, cool and slice into strips
Top with all ingredients artfully arranged in sections
Serve with soy sauce and wasabi on side
lunch.notes: Arrange ingredients in sections for visual appeal. Can use any cooked ingredients
lunch.fun_fact: Chirashi means scattered, referring to scattered toppings on rice in lunch bowl. Popular Japanese lunch

dinner.name: Japanese Sukiyaki (Japanese Hot Pot with Thinly Sliced Beef)
dinner.description: Japanese hot pot with thinly sliced beef and vegetables - interactive dinner
ingredients: 600g beef rib eye or sirloin, very thinly sliced
instructions: Prepare warishita by mixing soy sauce, mirin, sake, brown sugar, dashi
Heat shallow cast-iron sukiyaki pan or wide skillet over tabletop burner
Add 1 tablespoon beef fat or oil
Add several slices of beef; cook 10 seconds per side
Quickly add vegetables, tofu, mushrooms, noodles around beef
Bring to gentle simmer; cook 5-7 minutes until vegetables tender
Arrange in serving vessel at table
Crack raw egg into individual dipping cups
Dip cooked ingredients into raw egg before eating
Continue adding more ingredients and sauce as items cook
dinner.notes: Raw egg coating (tempering) prevents salty-sweet meat from overwhelming palate
dinner.fun_fact: Traditionally dipped in raw egg for silky, rich coating
